nodes.text: Driver:barnard (Barnard): A driver who achieved podium finishes in Formula E.

GrandPrix:são paulo eprix (São Paulo ePrix): An electric race where Bird won McLaren's maiden victory.
The season opening race where Barnard finished third.

RaceResult:barnard at jeddah eprix (Barnard at Jeddah ePrix): Barnard finished third at Race 1 of the Jeddah ePrix.
Barnard finished second at Race 2 of the Jeddah ePrix.
RaceResult:barnard at são paulo eprix (Barnard at São Paulo ePrix): Barnard finished third at the São Paulo ePrix.

nodes.text: RaceResult:sam bird at são paulo eprix (Sam Bird at São Paulo ePrix): Bird won McLaren's maiden electric race victory at the São Paulo ePrix.
Driver:sam bird (Sam Bird): A driver who replaced Rast at McLaren.
GrandPrix:jeddah eprix (Jeddah ePrix): The race where Barnard achieved another podium finish.
